meta.name: free talk 话题库
meta.source: 英文问句取自 GitHub 1599570912/IELTS-Speaking-AI（MIT License）题库，实测 62 条剔除 2 条考官身份核验题后为 60 条；中文翻译、追问、参考词汇、表达支架、参考回答为本项目自撰
meta.licenseNote: MIT 条款要求保留原作者版权声明，见文末 source 字段及 tools/freetalk/README.md
meta.mixNote: 范文语料池 = 星一班 L1（47 段）+ 高级班 L2（56 段，已剔除 L9 单元），两批混用；src 四元组 [表达, 编号, 起始秒, 结束秒]，逐字命中原文

topics.q: Where are you from?
topics.zh: 你来自哪里？
follow: Do you work or study?
What do you do for work/study?
Do you like your job/studies? Why?
topics.tips: 用 I come from… / I grew up in… 开头，再补一句这个地方的特点（食物、天气、节奏）。
topics.sample: I'm from China, from near Shanghai [L1.2.1]. I was born in [L1.1.1] a smaller city not far from there. My family moved here eight years ago when I was in high school [L1.1.1], so I've lived in two very different places and I like both for different reasons.
src: I'm from China, from near Shanghai
my family moved here eight years ago when I was in high school

topics.q: Do you work or study?
topics.zh: 你在工作还是上学？
follow: What do you do for work/study?
Do you like your job/studies? Why?
Where are you from?
topics.tips: 直接说现状，再加一句专业或年级：I am a … major in my … year.
topics.sample: I'm still a student, in my third year. To be honest [L2.2.1], I haven't made up my mind [L1.14.2] about the future, but I guess I still had a lot to learn [L2.24.1], which is fine for now.
src: I haven't made up my mind
I still had a lot to learn

topics.q: What do you do for work/study?
topics.zh: 你的工作/学业具体是做什么的？
follow: Do you work or study?
Do you like your job/studies? Why?
Where are you from?
topics.tips: 别只报专业名，说一件具体的日常事（做实验、写代码、赶报告），内容才立得住。
topics.sample: I study computer science, and most of my week goes into coursework and one long lab project. Last summer I was working as an intern [L2.5.1] at a small company, which taught me more than a semester of lectures.

topics.q: Do you like your job/studies? Why?
topics.zh: 你喜欢自己的工作/学业吗？为什么？
follow: What do you do for work/study?
Do you work or study?
Where are you from?
topics.tips: 喜欢就说喜欢什么，不喜欢就说哪一点烦，但结尾要转回积极：But overall…。
topics.sample: I do like it, though it can be tiring. At the end of the day [L2.U7.1] I'm usually pretty worn out [L2.U7.1], but I'd rather be busy than bored, and the subject itself keeps me interested.
src: At the end of the day

topics.q: Do you have a large family?
topics.zh: 你家里人多吗？
follow: How much time do you spend with your family?
What do you like to do together as a family?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
topics.tips: 先答大不大，再补人数构成：There are … of us / I am an only child.
topics.sample: Not really. There are four of us [L2.3.1] at home, so it's a small family. I don't have any relatives here [L1.2.1], which means most of my extended family I only get to see on holidays.
src: I don't have any relatives here

topics.q: How much time do you spend with your family?
topics.zh: 你花多少时间和家人在一起？
follow: What do you like to do together as a family?
Do you have a large family?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
topics.tips: 用频率副词（most evenings / once a week / during holidays）把时间说具体。
topics.sample: Most evenings, really. On weekends we visit relatives [L1.2.1] or just sit and talk over dinner. I've been meaning to call [L2.2.1] my cousins more often, but I haven't gotten around to it [L2.7.1].
src: I haven't gotten around to it

topics.q: What do you like to do together as a family?
topics.zh: 你们一家喜欢一起做什么？
follow: How much time do you spend with your family?
Do you have a large family?
How often do you meet your friends?
topics.tips: 挑一件具体的事讲细节（谁做什么、什么时候），比罗列三个活动强。
topics.sample: We like cooking and eating together, mostly. My mom's soup [L1.2.1] is the best part of any gathering. On holidays we always had a great time [L1.3.1] around the table, talking for hours.
src: we always had a great time

topics.q: Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
topics.zh: 你更喜欢和家人还是朋友待在一起？
follow: How often do you meet your friends?
What do you usually do with your friends?
How much time do you spend with your family?
topics.tips: 用 It depends on … 分情况回答，能自然把两面都说出来。
topics.sample: It depends on [L1.6.2] my mood. With family I can just relax and be myself, with friends I joke around more. I'd say family for rest, friends for fun.

topics.q: How often do you meet your friends?
topics.zh: 你多久见一次朋友？
follow: What do you usually do with your friends?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
How much time do you spend with your family?
topics.tips: 给频率 + 原因（课表冲突、住得远），再补一句线上联系也算。
topics.sample: Not as often as I'd like, maybe once a week. We're all busy with coursework, but when we do meet we got along really well [L2.1.2] and lose track of time.

topics.q: What do you usually do with your friends?
topics.zh: 你和朋友通常一起做什么？
follow: How often do you meet your friends?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 讲一次具体的经历，用 Last time we… 开头，回答立刻有画面。
topics.sample: Last time we went to my friend James's place for dinner. What a feast [L2.2.2]! He's a great cook and he loves inviting people over [L2.2.2], so we just ate and talked all night.

topics.q: What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.zh: 你空闲时喜欢做什么？
follow: Do you have any hobbies?
When did you start this hobby?
Is it an expensive hobby?
topics.tips: 给一个主活动 + 一个替补（when I am too tired…），答案更立体。
topics.sample: I read a lot, and I go for walks. I'm not very good at [L1.1.1] team sports, so I prefer things I can do alone, where I can clear my head.

topics.q: Do you have any hobbies?
topics.zh: 你有什么爱好吗？
follow: When did you start this hobby?
Is it an expensive hobby?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 说清「认真到什么程度」：I am not serious about it / I take it fairly seriously.
topics.sample: I do, photography. I'm not very serious about it, but when I started I found I was actually pretty good at it [L2.25.1], which is why I kept going.
src: I found I was actually pretty good at it

topics.q: When did you start this hobby?
topics.zh: 你什么时候开始这个爱好的？
follow: Is it an expensive hobby?
Do you have any hobbies?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 用 I picked it up … ago / I have been doing it on and off since … 表达断续坚持。
topics.sample: I started in high school, when I first got a camera of my own. Before that I'd always used my phone. It felt good to go out on my own [L2.24.2] and take pictures.

topics.q: Is it an expensive hobby?
topics.zh: 这个爱好花钱多吗？
follow: When did you start this hobby?
Do you have any hobbies?
What hobbies are popular in your country?
topics.tips: 先给结论 It can be / Not really，再举一个价格细节支撑，比空说贵不贵有力。
topics.sample: It can be, but it doesn't have to be. The gear adds up, but I buy second-hand. To be honest [L2.2.1], my best photos were taken with my cheapest lens.

topics.q: What hobbies are popular in your country?
topics.zh: 你们国家什么爱好比较流行？
follow: What do you like to do in your free time?
Do you have any hobbies?
Do you think hobbies should be shared with other people?
topics.tips: 用 … has really taken off recently 描述流行趋势，别只列清单。
topics.sample: Running and short videos, honestly. Jogging has really taken off among young people here, especially in the evening. And almost everyone watches short videos now — it's hard to predict [L2.2.3] what's next.

topics.q: Do you think hobbies should be shared with other people?
topics.zh: 你觉得爱好应该和别人一起做吗？
follow: What hobbies are popular in your country?
Do you have any hobbies?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 观点题用 I think it depends on the person 开头，再分两面说，最后落到自己。
topics.sample: I think it depends on the person. Some hobbies are better shared, because other people push you. On the other hand [L2.U7.1], I also need quiet time alone to recharge.

topics.q: Do you use the internet very much?
topics.zh: 你上网多吗？
follow: What do you do on the internet?
When did you first start using the internet?
Do you think the internet is useful?
topics.tips: 给一个量化的说法（several hours a day / far too much），比 very much 更实。
topics.sample: Far too much. Several hours a day, easily. I use it for classes and research, but also for scrolling. I'm trying to cut down, but it's hard to predict [L2.2.3] where the time goes.

topics.q: When did you first start using the internet?
topics.zh: 你最早是什么时候开始上网的？
follow: Do you use the internet very much?
What do you do on the internet?
How has technology changed the way people communicate?
topics.tips: 对比过去和现在的设备/速度，用 Back then… Now… 结构。
topics.sample: Back then we had one family desktop, and the connection was slow. Now it's everywhere. It's amazing how much computers have changed the way computers work [L2.U4.2] in my lifetime.

topics.q: What do you do on the internet?
topics.zh: 你上网都做些什么？
follow: Do you use the internet very much?
Do you think the internet is useful?
What are the pros and cons of children using the internet?
topics.tips: 分两类说：有用的（查资料/学东西）+ 纯消遣的，显出自我觉察。
topics.sample: Two kinds. The useful side, tutorials and courses, and the rabbit hole, which I fall into too often. I'm not very good at [L1.1.1] balancing the two, honestly.

topics.q: Do you think the internet is useful?
topics.zh: 你觉得互联网有用吗？
follow: What do you do on the internet?
What are the pros and cons of children using the internet?
How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.tips: 别一边倒。用 It is useful, but… 承认代价，观点更可信。
topics.sample: It's useful, but it's a double-edged sword. It gives you access to everything, but a lot of it is noise. You have to use your common sense [L1.11.1] to separate the two.

topics.q: What are the pros and cons of children using the internet?
topics.zh: 孩子上网有哪些好处和坏处？
follow: Do you think the internet is useful?
What do you do on the internet?
How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.tips: 利弊题用 On the one hand… On the other hand…，最后给一条自己的建议收尾。
topics.sample: On the one hand, kids can learn almost anything online, which is incredible. On the other hand [L2.U7.1], too much screen time is a real problem. I think supervision matters more than banning it.

topics.q: Do you like music?
topics.zh: 你喜欢音乐吗？
follow: What kind of music do you like?
Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
topics.tips: 说清音乐在你生活里的角色（背景音 / 专注用 / 睡前），比 yes, very much 有内容。
topics.sample: I do, music is a big part of my life. I listen while I study and when I walk. I can't stand it when [L2.4.3] a room is totally silent, so there's always something playing.

topics.q: What kind of music do you like?
topics.zh: 你喜欢什么类型的音乐？
follow: Do you like music?
Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
What kind of music do you like?
topics.tips: 给一主一次两种风格，并说「什么时候听哪种」，答案立刻具体。
topics.sample: Mostly mellow stuff, and some rock. When I'm working I like soft instrumentals, when I'm out I want energy. It depends on [L1.6.2] my mood, honestly.

topics.q: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
topics.zh: 你学过乐器吗？
follow: Which instrument would you prefer to study, the piano or the violin?
Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
What kind of music do you like?
topics.tips: 学过又放弃是很真实的答案，用 I gave up because… 讲清原因即可。
topics.sample: I tried piano as a kid and gave up. To be honest [L2.2.1] I'm not very good at [L1.1.1] practising, and I lost patience. I wish I'd stuck with it.

topics.q: Which instrument would you prefer to study, the piano or the violin?
topics.zh: 钢琴和小提琴，你更想学哪个？
follow: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
Do you like music?
topics.tips: 二选一题要给出「为什么不是另一个」的理由，这是得分点。
topics.sample: The piano, because I already know a little. The violin sounds beautiful, but it's much harder to begin. I'd rather [L2.12.1] pick up where I left off with the piano than start from zero.

topics.q: Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
topics.zh: 你觉得孩子学乐器重要吗？
follow: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
What role should technology play in education?
How important is it for students to learn practical skills?
topics.tips: 观点题先让步 Admittedly…，再转折 But I think…,显得思考过两面。
topics.sample: Admittedly it's not for everyone. But I think it builds discipline and patience, which matter everywhere. I should have studied [L2.26.1] music more seriously when I was young — I really regret that [L2.26.2] now.

topics.q: Do you like sport?
topics.zh: 你喜欢运动吗？
follow: What sports do you play?
What is the most popular sport in your country?
What are the benefits of playing sport?
topics.tips: 区分「看」和「做」：I like watching… more than playing…，这是很自然的展开。
topics.sample: I like watching more than playing. I'm not very good at [L1.1.1] most sports, but I love watching basketball for the pace.

topics.q: What sports do you play?
topics.zh: 你做什么运动？
follow: Do you like sport?
What are the benefits of playing sport?
Do you think children should play sport?
topics.tips: 说频率和水平（twice a week / badly but happily），避免空泛。
topics.sample: I jog twice a week, badly but happily, and I swim sometimes. I'm trying to get in shape [L2.21.1] for summer, so I've been more consistent lately.

topics.q: What is the most popular sport in your country?
topics.zh: 你们国家最流行的运动是什么？
follow: What is your favorite sport to watch on TV?
Do you like sport?
What sports do you play?
topics.tips: 不只报名字，说它流行在哪（ grassroots 参与 / 电视转播 / 民族情绪）。
topics.sample: Table tennis, that's for sure [L1.4.1]. It's everywhere, from schoolyards to office buildings, and almost everyone knows how to play.

topics.q: What is your favorite sport to watch on TV?
topics.zh: 你最喜欢在电视上看什么运动？
follow: Do you like sport?
What is the most popular sport in your country?
What sports do you play?
topics.tips: 讲一个看的理由（节奏、悬念、解说），比报项目名更有话。
topics.sample: Basketball, because of the pace. With most sports I zone out [L2.23.1] after a while, but a close basketball game keeps me glued to the screen.

topics.q: Do you think children should play sport?
topics.zh: 你觉得孩子应该参加体育运动吗？
follow: What are the benefits of playing sport?
Do you like sport?
How important is it for students to learn practical skills?
topics.tips: 观点题用 I think so, as long as… 加条件，观点更严密。
topics.sample: I think so, as long as it's not forced. Sport teaches teamwork and how to handle losing. For kids, playing with friends — that's half the fun [L1.16.1] — so it should stay fun.

topics.q: What are the benefits of playing sport?
topics.zh: 运动有什么好处？
follow: Do you think children should play sport?
What sports do you play?
Do you like sport?
topics.tips: 身体 + 心理各说一条，再落到自己的体验，最有说服力。
topics.sample: Two big ones: physical health, and mental. When I'm working out [L2.10.1] regularly I sleep better and my mood is steadier. It's the routine as much as the exercise.

topics.q: Describe a person you admire.
topics.zh: 描述一个你敬佩的人。
bullets: How you know about this person
And explain why you admire this person
follow: What qualities make a person admirable?
Do you think children need role models?
What influence can famous people have on society?
topics.tips: 四个要点逐个覆盖，最后 why 那条要多说两句——那是考官真正等的部分。
topics.sample: The person I admire most is my mother. She has a good sense of humor [L2.1.1] but also this quiet strength. She's the sort of person who [L2.19.1] quietly fixes everything, and she never once complained about it. I remember she worked long hours while she was sick herself, yet she was still waiting for me when I came home from school [L2.24.2]. In her own small way she helped make the world a better place [L2.U4.1], and that's who I want to become.
src: waiting for me when I came home from school
make the world a better place

topics.q: Describe a memorable journey you have taken.
topics.zh: 描述一次难忘的旅行。
bullets: And explain why this journey was memorable
follow: What are the benefits of traveling?
How has traveling changed over the years?
Do you think space travel will be common in the future?
topics.tips: 「为什么难忘」要落在具体的一件事上（一次意外、一个人），不要只说风景很美。
topics.sample: The most memorable was a family trip years ago. We took a wrong turn and ended up in a tiny village with no signal. It wasn't a disaster — we always had a great time [L1.3.1] and met people we still talk about. On the way back our car broke down: our map was long gone [L2.10.2], our phones were dead, and I started to panic. My father just laughed and asked a farmer for help. It made me want to go out on my own [L2.24.2] more often.
src: we always had a great time

topics.q: Describe a skill you learned recently.
topics.zh: 描述你最近学会的一项技能。
bullets: How long it took you to learn
And explain how this skill has helped you
follow: What skills are most important in today's world?
How do people usually learn new skills?
Should schools teach more practical skills?
topics.tips: 讲学习过程中的一个挫败点 + 一个突破点，这是 Part 2 最有内容的结构。
topics.sample: I recently learned to cook, by watching my mom [L2.18.2]. At first everything went wrong, which was frustrating. But once I reached that breakthrough stage [L2.25.1], it started to feel natural. I also learned how to communicate with people [L2.19.2] in the kitchen — you taste, you adjust, you explain what you are doing. The first time I cooked a whole meal for my family, I felt really proud of myself [L2.25.1].
src: learned to cook by watching my mom
learned how to communicate with people

topics.q: Describe a place you would like to visit.
topics.zh: 描述一个你想去的地方。
bullets: How you know about this place
And explain why you want to visit this place
follow: Why do people like to travel to different places?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of tourism?
How do you think tourism will change in the future?
topics.tips: 「你怎么知道这地方的」很容易被忽略，别漏——它让故事有来源。
topics.sample: I'd love to visit Tibet someday. I saw a documentary about it, and it made me want to go there and see it for myself [L1.20.4]. The landscape looks unreal — huge mountains and almost nobody around. What I really want is to go out on my own [L2.24.2] for a couple of weeks, slow down, and just walk. I've been meaning to [L2.7.1] plan it for years, but I haven't gotten around to it [L2.7.1]. Maybe this summer.
src: I haven't gotten around to it

topics.q: What are the advantages of online learning?
topics.zh: 在线学习有哪些优势？
follow: Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
What role should technology play in education?
How has education changed in recent years?
topics.tips: Part 3 要给「分析型」答案：先答，再说条件或反例，别停在描述。
topics.sample: The big advantage is flexibility. You can learn at your own pace, wherever you are. But you have to be aware of [L2.13.2] the downside — without a teacher there, it's easy to fall behind.

topics.q: How has education changed in recent years?
topics.zh: 近年来教育发生了怎样的变化？
follow: What role should technology play in education?
Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
What are the advantages of online learning?
topics.tips: 讲「从什么变成什么」，用 There has been a shift from… to… 结构。
topics.sample: Education has changed a lot. Back then it was rote learning, that's for sure [L1.4.1]. Now it's more about problem-solving and working in teams, which I think is better.

topics.q: Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
topics.zh: 你觉得传统教学方法还有效吗？
follow: What role should technology play in education?
What are the advantages of online learning?
How has education changed in recent years?
topics.tips: 不要一刀切。说清「在什么条件下有效」，这是 Part 3 的高分思维。
topics.sample: Traditional methods still work in some contexts. Are they outdated? Not at all [L1.17.2] if they involve real discussion. But pure rote learning feels like a thing of the past.

topics.q: What role should technology play in education?
topics.zh: 技术在教育中应扮演什么角色？
follow: Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
What are the advantages of online learning?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
topics.tips: 用 should 类题目给立场 + 边界：It should be…, but it must not become…。
topics.sample: Technology should be a tool, not a substitute. It can help students learn to be more independent [L2.24.1], but it must not replace a teacher who notices when you're stuck.

topics.q: How important is it for students to learn practical skills?
topics.zh: 学生学习实用技能有多重要？
follow: Should schools teach more practical skills?
What skills are most important in today's world?
How has education changed in recent years?
topics.tips: 承认 trade-off（时间有限）再表态，观点更成熟。
topics.sample: Very important, because not everyone goes into academic work. Practical skills help you make good money [L1.14.2] and stay flexible. But there's a trade-off — time is limited.

topics.q: What are the benefits of studying abroad?
topics.zh: 出国留学有什么好处？
follow: How has education changed in recent years?
What are the main challenges facing young people today?
How important is it to preserve cultural traditions?
topics.tips: 说好处的同时提一句代价（成本/不公平），显示你能看两面。
topics.sample: The main benefit is immersion. You learn the language for real, though it takes a bit of getting used to [L1.21.2] at first. But it's expensive, and not everyone can afford it.
src: It takes a bit of getting used to

topics.q: What are the main environmental problems in your country?
topics.zh: 你们国家主要的环境问题是什么？
follow: How can individuals help protect the environment?
Do you think governments are doing enough to tackle climate change?
What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
topics.tips: 列 2 个问题并各说一句成因或影响，不要只报名词。
topics.sample: Air quality is the obvious one in big cities, and waste is another. That's not an easy question to answer [L1.2.1], how to fix it, but it's hard to ignore.
src: that's not an easy question to answer

topics.q: How can individuals help protect the environment?
topics.zh: 个人可以如何保护环境？
follow: Is it realistic to expect people to change their lifestyle to help the environment?
What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
What are the main environmental problems in your country?
topics.tips: 先给具体做法，再指出个人力量的边界，这是成熟答案的标志。
topics.sample: Individuals can do a lot — reuse, cut waste, take public transport. Some cities even ban private cars [L1.4.1] downtown. But the big changes have to come from companies and government too.

topics.q: Do you think governments are doing enough to tackle climate change?
topics.zh: 你认为政府在应对气候变化上做得够吗？
follow: What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
How can individuals help protect the environment?
How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
topics.tips: 区分「承诺」和「执行」，用 There is a gap between… and…。
topics.sample: Honestly, not enough. There's a gap between what's promised and what's enforced. So no, not yet anyway [L2.14.2].

topics.q: What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
topics.zh: 企业在环保中应承担什么角色？
follow: Do you think governments are doing enough to tackle climate change?
How can individuals help protect the environment?
What are the main environmental problems in your country?
topics.tips: 提到 greenwashing（漂绿）这类概念能显出你有实质观点。
topics.sample: Businesses have a big responsibility. But before we celebrate any company's promises, we should make sure we've got our facts straight [L2.14.1] — a lot of it turns out to be greenwashing.

topics.q: How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
topics.zh: 未来城市会如何变得更环保？
follow: Is it realistic to expect people to change their lifestyle to help the environment?
How might technology change education in the future?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
topics.tips: 给 2~3 个具体方向（密度/公交/改造），避免空说 will be greener。
topics.sample: I think cities will get denser and greener. More public transportation [L1.4.2], more walking and cycling, more green space. The suburbs might even shrink.

topics.q: Is it realistic to expect people to change their lifestyle to help the environment?
topics.zh: 期待人们为环保改变生活方式现实吗？
follow: How can individuals help protect the environment?
What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
topics.tips: 关键论点：让环保成为「默认选项」而非道德选择——这是很强的 Part 3 观点。
topics.sample: Partly realistic. People can change, but only if it's made easy — after a while I got used to it [L2.11.3] with reusable bags, for example. The trick is making the green option the default.
src: after a while I got used to it

topics.q: How has technology changed the way people communicate?
topics.zh: 科技如何改变了人们的沟通方式？
follow: What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.tips: 对比 breadth 与 depth（广度 vs 深度）是这类题的经典高分框架。
topics.sample: It's made communication instant. You can keep in touch with everyone you need to [L2.23.1], anywhere, anytime. But we talk more and connect less — broader, but shallower.
src: keep in touch with everyone you need to

topics.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media?
topics.zh: 社交媒体的利弊是什么？
follow: How has technology changed the way people communicate?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.tips: 两边各给一条，并指出同一个机制如何同时产生利弊（例如连接 vs 比较）。
topics.sample: The good part is connection and community. The bad part is comparison — everyone shows their best side. People are at their best when you're sincerely interested in other people [L2.19.2], not just scrolling.

topics.q: Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
topics.zh: 你认为人工智能会取代人类劳动者吗？
follow: How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
What skills are most important in today's world?
topics.tips: 区分「任务」和「整个职业」是这题的关键区分点，说出来就显得专业。
topics.sample: I think it'll replace some tasks, not whole jobs. Repetitive work will go, but work that needs judgment and human contact will stay. The challenge is helping people retrain for something more practical [L2.26.1].

topics.q: How might technology change education in the future?
topics.zh: 未来技术会如何改变教育？
follow: What role should technology play in education?
What are the advantages of online learning?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
topics.tips: 给一个具体设想 + 一个你担心的点，答案就有观点而不只是预测。
topics.sample: I think AI tutors will become normal, giving every student instant feedback. Learning anything will feel like it wasn't an impossible thing after all [L2.25.1]. But I worry students might become too passive.
src: wasn't an impossible thing after all

topics.q: What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
topics.zh: 我们越来越依赖技术，有哪些潜在风险？
follow: How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
topics.tips: 举一个具体风险场景（断网、技能退化），比泛泛说 dangerous 有力。
topics.sample: The main risk is that we forget how to do things ourselves. If a system goes down, we're stuck — you can't always change by yourself [L2.21.2] when the tools do everything for you.
src: You can't always change by yourself

topics.q: How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.zh: 如何确保技术被负责任地使用？
follow: What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
What role should governments play in people's lives?
topics.tips: 给 2 条可操作措施（透明度/问责），再加一条教育层面的，结构完整。
topics.sample: Two things: transparency, so the public can have a clearer picture [L2.14.2] of how decisions are made, and accountability, so someone answers when it goes wrong. Plus education, so people understand what they're using.

topics.q: How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.zh: 近几十年家庭生活发生了什么变化？
follow: What are the main challenges facing young people today?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
How important is it to preserve cultural traditions?
topics.tips: 用具体变化对照（规模、地理分散、双职工），别只说 it changed a lot。
topics.sample: Families are smaller and more spread out now. I don't have any relatives here [L1.2.1], so I only see them on holidays. Many households are two-income, which changes how time gets spent.
src: I don't have any relatives here

topics.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
topics.zh: 住在大城市有什么利弊？
follow: How can communities be made stronger?
What are the main challenges facing young people today?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.tips: 各给 2 条，并指出利弊同源（机会多 = 竞争和成本高）。
topics.sample: Cities offer opportunity, and you're right downtown [L1.7.2] where everything is. But the cost of living is brutal and the commute wears you down. The density gives and takes at the same time.

topics.q: How important is it to preserve cultural traditions?
topics.zh: 保护文化传统有多重要？
follow: How can communities be made stronger?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
What role should governments play in people's lives?
topics.tips: 区分「保存」与「冻结」——传统要活着就得变，这是高分论点。
topics.sample: I think it matters, because traditions carry identity. It is said that [L1.22.1] they hold a people together. But they shouldn't be frozen — a tradition that doesn't change eventually dies.

topics.q: What role should governments play in people's lives?
topics.zh: 政府应在民众生活中扮演什么角色？
follow: What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
How can communities be made stronger?
What are the main challenges facing young people today?
topics.tips: 这题要立场清晰：强在公共服务，弱在私人选择。给一条界线。
topics.sample: Governments should provide the basics — safety, education, healthcare. But when they meddle in private choices, it's not worth the risk [L1.11.1] of losing freedom. Strong on public goods, light on private life.

topics.q: How can communities be made stronger?
topics.zh: 如何让社区更有凝聚力？
follow: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.tips: 给具体机制（共享空间 / 参与决策），避免口号式答案。
topics.sample: Shared spaces and events, I think. When people actually say let's get together soon [L1.21.2] and mean it, trust grows. It's not complicated, just effort.

topics.q: What are the main challenges facing young people today?
topics.zh: 当今年轻人面临的主要挑战是什么？
follow: What are the main environmental problems in your country?
How can communities be made stronger?
What skills are most important in today's world?
topics.tips: 经济 + 心理两条线都说，并指出它们的关联，答案更有深度。
topics.sample: Two big ones. The job market is uncertain — unemployment is going to keep getting worse [L2.23.1] in some fields. And there's constant pressure from comparison on social media. The two feed each other.
